title: Reliability Dynamics in a Two-Site Dissipative Quantum Spin Chain
summary: As a key index for applications of a device, the device's reliability is its ability to survive (function normally over time) under the influence of some environment. In this paper we present a quantum energy-storing device model with a quantum spin chain, whose environment influence is described by the Lindblad master equation. Here the device survives if the spin system stays in the state with nonzero excitations; otherwise, it fails.
